name: build-buttons
description: One compact status bar button per project. Click the name to run the default build task, click the arrow to expand all task buttons.

buildTasks.filePath.markdownDescription: Workspace-relative path of the per-project button definition file (`buildtasks.json`).

buildTasks.autoCollapseSeconds.description: Seconds before an expanded row of buttons collapses by itself. 0 disables auto-collapse.
